description: Nine polyphonic logic gates, each combining its own inputs with any of the standard logic operations

params.text: Off gives every polyphonic channel its own gate; on collects the channels of an input as separate inputs to one monophonic gate
Sets oversampling to off, 2x, 4x, 8x, 16x or 32x, cutting aliasing when the outputs are used as audio; off costs the least CPU
Sets the low and high output voltages: 0-1V, 0-5V or 0-10V for CV work, or the bipolar 1V, 5V and 10V pairs for audio
Removes DC offset from the outputs, which matters when they are used as audio
Sets the voltage an input must rise above to count as high, summed with the HIGH THRESH input; -10V to 10V, 2V by default
Sets the voltage an input must fall to before it counts as low, summed with the LOW THRESH input; -10V to 10V, 0.1V by default
Fixed at three dashes, because there is no row above whose output could be reused
Picks an output from a row above to include as an extra input to this row without a sample delay; three dashes takes none
Sets the logic for that row: AND, OR, XOR 1, XOR ODD, NAND, NOR, XNOR 1, XNOR ODD, or defer, which passes the row's inputs down to the row below

inputs.text: Shifts the high threshold used by every input, added to the HIGH THRESH knob
Shifts the low threshold used by every input, added to the LOW THRESH knob
One of the two gate inputs for that row, ignored while unpatched

outputs.text: Carries the result of that row's logic operation, and constant 0V when the row is deferred or has no inputs

notes: with a single input AND, OR, XOR 1 and XOR ODD pass it through, while NAND, NOR, XNOR 1 and XNOR ODD invert it
the two thresholds are swapped internally whenever the high threshold is set below the low one
menu: Oversample filter quality — 10th order by default, with 8th order and a cheaper 6th order; 10th and 8th cut at 80% of Nyquist and 6th at 50%
